summary: Iteration 6 testing complete. All 15 homepage features tested and passed. Homepage loads at / without authentication. Sticky nav bar with Operoo brand, Sign In, and Get Started buttons. Hero section with correct headline and 2 CTAs. Product Preview shows 3 mockups (Admin Dashboard, Staff Interface, Guest Chat). How It Works has 3 steps. Features section has 6 cards. Responsive section with device frames. Final CTA with 'Create Admin Account' button. Footer with brand and copyright. Logged-in users redirected to /dashboard. Mobile responsive works on 390px viewport. Registration assigns admin role.
